# 2026 minimum basic health insurance premiums by Swiss jurisdiction

Source: [KVG26 mapper](https://kvgmapper26.github.io/). Extracted directly from the embedded GeoJSON of each linked map scenario. The year 2026 follows the map's KVG26 title; the maps do not explicitly state the monetary unit or billing period. Amounts are preserved as shown; no currency or billing-period conversion was applied.

**Validity:** These premiums are valid only for the 2026 premium year. They are invalid for 2027; obtain a new 2027 dataset instead. Official premium reference: [Priminfo (Federal Office of Public Health)](https://www.priminfo.admin.ch/de/praemien). The jurisdiction-level values below were extracted from the linked KVG mapper pages, not downloaded directly from Priminfo.

**Coverage:** 2175 jurisdictions × 24 scenarios = 52200 records. Adult = age 26+; young = age 19–25. Accident cover is included or excluded; deductible is in CHF. One row is kept for each jurisdiction in every scenario, including areas with no published premium (blank fields). Geometry is omitted.

**Source field mapping:** `gemeinde.NAME` → `municipality`; `BFS_NUMMER` → `bfs_number`; `BFS` → `bfs`; `Region` → `region`; `Prämie` → `minimum_premium`; `Versicherer` → `best_insurer`; `Tarifbezeichnung` → `best_model`; `Tarif` → `tariff`; `Tariftyp` → `tariff_type`; `Prämie_old` → `previous_minimum_premium`; `Versicherer_old` → `previous_insurer`; `Tarifbezeichnung_old` → `previous_model`; `Tarif_old` → `previous_tariff`; `Tariftyp_old` → `previous_tariff_type`; `%_increase` → `percent_increase`; `Rec` → `recommendation`; `Action` → `action`; `Savincr` → `premium_change`. Each source property appears once in both exports. `previous_*`, `recommendation`, `action`, `percent_increase`, and `premium_change` reproduce the map's comparison/recommendation fields; they are not additional 2026 offers.

The CSV contains the same records and properties, plus explicit `year`, `age_group`, `accident_cover`, `deductible_chf`, and `source_url` columns. For each table below, these scenario values and the source URL are specified in the heading.

**Jurisdictions with missing premiums:** Staatswald Galm (BFS 2391); Comunanza Cadenazzo/Monteceneri (BFS 5391); Comunanza Capriasca/Lugano (BFS 5394).
